# Hanbridge Mandarin

> > Hanbridge Mandarin is an online Chinese language school offering Mandarin courses, HSK test preparation, and cultural education for learners worldwide.

Based in Shenzhen, Hanbridge Mandarin provides comprehensive Chinese language training including HSK preparation, AP Chinese courses, business Mandarin, and cultural immersion programs covering Chinese philosophy, history, literature, and folk customs. The platform offers structured courses alongside daily learning resources for all proficiency levels.

## Key Topics

- HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test)
- AP Chinese
- Mandarin learning strategies
- Chinese proverbs and idioms (chengyu)
- Chinese philosophy and folk customs
- Traditional Chinese festivals
- Chinese history and literature
- Business Mandarin
- Beginner Chinese
- Cultural customs and etiquette
- Language learning tips
- Daily Chinese phrases
- Reading comprehension
- Shenzhen language school

## Getting Started

- [How to start learning with Hanbridge Mandarin](https://www.hanbridgemandarin.com/how-to-start-learning-with-hanrbridge-mandarin): Getting started guide: enrollment, trial lesson & study plan setup
- [Request Cooperate Chinese Training](https://www.hanbridgemandarin.com/request): Corporate training inquiry form for business Mandarin courses

## Core Courses

- [Learn Philosophy and Folk Customs](https://www.hanbridgemandarin.com/course/culture-course/philosophy-and-folk-customs): Chinese philosophy & folk customs course covering festivals & traditions
- [Learn Chinese History and Literature](https://www.hanbridgemandarin.com/course/culture-course/chinese-history-and-literature): 5000-year Chinese history & classical literature culture course
- [汉语阅读课程 (Chinese Reading Course)](https://www.hanbridgemandarin.com/zh-hans/course/chinese-reading): Chinese reading course for HSK & AP Chinese comprehension skills

## Learning Resources & Tips

- [Chinese Learning Tips](https://www.hanbridgemandarin.com/article/chinese-learning-tips): Teacher-written tips for effective Chinese & HSK learning strategies

## Daily Practice Materials

- [Ask Directions](https://www.hanbridgemandarin.com/online-self-study/daily-reading/detail/1742): Basic Chinese sentences for asking directions with metro & plaza examples
- [A prodigal who returns is more precious than gold in Chinese](https://www.hanbridgemandarin.com/online-self-study/sentence-of-the-day/detail/3241): Chinese proverb & chengyu: prodigal returns phrase lesson
- [To look for a flaw which doesn't exist in Chinese](https://www.hanbridgemandarin.com/online-self-study/sentence-of-the-day/detail/3095): Chinese idiom: 'look for bones in an egg' proverb lesson
- [eye](https://www.hanbridgemandarin.com/online-self-study/daily-phrases/detail/1344): Body parts vocabulary: how to say 'eye' in Chinese
